title: Advertising Campaign Console
description: A comprehensive campaign management and reporting platform for advertising workflows. Enables teams to create, schedule, and monitor ad campaigns across multiple channels including display, search, and social media. Features real-time performance dashboards with key metrics like CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Integrates with major ad networks and provides automated budget optimization recommendations based on historical performance data.

title: Short-form Clips Editor
description: End-to-end short-form video editing and publishing pipeline built for content creators and social media managers. Supports trimming, transitions, text overlays, and audio mixing with a drag-and-drop timeline interface. Includes auto-captioning powered by speech recognition, aspect ratio presets for different platforms (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), and one-click publishing to connected social accounts. Processing runs on a scalable cloud infrastructure to handle high-volume batch exports.

title: Portfolio Audit Log
description: A read-only audit trail system that tracks and records all metadata changes across the project portfolio. Captures who made what change, when, and provides before/after diffs for every modification. Supports advanced filtering by date range, user, and change type. Designed to meet SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements with tamper-proof log storage and automated retention policies. Exports to CSV and PDF for external auditors.

title: Legacy CSV Import
description: One-off bulk importer designed to migrate data from legacy spreadsheet-based systems into the modern project hub platform. Handles CSV, TSV, and Excel formats with configurable column mapping, data validation rules, and duplicate detection. Includes a dry-run mode for previewing imports before committing changes. Scheduled for retirement once the final batch of historical data has been migrated from the three remaining legacy systems.

title: Unified Analytics Hub
description: Centralized analytics platform that aggregates data from multiple internal tools and third-party services into a single unified dashboard. Provides customizable widgets for tracking KPIs, user engagement metrics, and business health indicators. Features automated weekly report generation, anomaly detection alerts, and drill-down capabilities for deep-dive analysis. Built on a columnar data warehouse for sub-second query performance across billions of events.

title: Authentication Gateway
description: Enterprise-grade authentication and authorization gateway serving as the single entry point for all internal microservices. Implements OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, and OpenID Connect protocols with support for multi-factor authentication and passwordless login via WebAuthn. Handles token lifecycle management, session revocation, and role-based access control policies. Processes over 50,000 authentication requests per minute with 99.99% uptime SLA.

title: Component Design System
description: Shared design system package providing a consistent set of React UI primitives used across all micro-frontend surfaces. Includes buttons, forms, modals, data tables, navigation components, and complex patterns like file uploaders and date pickers. Ships with full accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), Storybook documentation, visual regression testing, and semantic versioning. Currently used by 12 production applications with over 80 components in the library.

title: Notification Service
description: Multi-channel notification delivery system supporting email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messages. Features a template engine with variable interpolation, A/B testing for notification copy, and intelligent delivery scheduling to optimize open rates based on user timezone and engagement patterns. Includes an admin panel for managing notification preferences, delivery logs, and bounce/complaint handling for email reputation management.

title: Internal Search Platform
description: Full-text search engine powering search across all internal tools, documentation, and project data. Built on Elasticsearch with custom analyzers for technical content, fuzzy matching, and faceted search. Supports real-time indexing with sub-second latency from data change to search availability. Includes search analytics to track popular queries, zero-result rates, and click-through patterns for continuous relevance tuning.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Manager
description: Internal continuous integration and deployment orchestration tool managing the build, test, and release lifecycle for all engineering projects. Supports parallel test execution, canary deployments, automatic rollbacks on failure, and environment promotion workflows. Integrates with GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform for end-to-end infrastructure-as-code deployments. Tracks build metrics, deployment frequency, and change failure rates aligned with DORA metrics.
